hypotheses.name: search_beats_baseline
hypotheses.description: Agent-guided search finds policies that outperform the frozen Ridge LSMC baseline on aggregate score

hypotheses.name: diversity_helps
hypotheses.description: Maintaining behavioral diversity via islands produces better final solutions than single-population search
hypotheses.success_criterion: 4-island run best_score > 1-island run best_score (paired comparison over 3 seeds)

hypotheses.name: behavior_profiling_guides
hypotheses.description: BehaviorProfile-informed context retrieval improves search efficiency vs chronological retrieval
hypotheses.success_criterion: v5 retrieval reaches same score in fewer context rounds than v4 retrieval

hypotheses.name: mechanism_cards_reduce_regression
hypotheses.description: MechanismCard-based failure memory reduces repeated failure modes

hypotheses.name: analogy_transfer_works
hypotheses.description: Cross-algorithm transfer via matched control shows positive effect size
hypotheses.success_criterion: mean effect_size > 0.01 across analogy experiments with p < 0.05

hypotheses.name: conditional_algorithm_advantage
hypotheses.description: Different algorithm families show conditional advantages on specific instance slices
hypotheses.success_criterion: at least 2 algorithms each dominate on a non-trivial instance slice (>10% of instances)
